statement: In the 47-byte DualSense output common block, mute_button_led is byte 8, valid_flag2 byte 38, lightbar_setup byte 41, led_brightness byte 42, player_leds byte 43 and lightbar red/green/blue bytes 44-46. In USB output report 0x02 each sits one byte later (report ID first).

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 270-298 and 309-315 (common struct with 47-byte size assertion, USB wrapper); SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 169-192 (same offsets as commented indices, names ucMicLightMode/ucLedAnim/ucLedBrightness/ucPadLights); VIIPER dualsense.md 158-184 (same order: MuteLightMode, LightFade, LightBrightness, PlayerLeds, LedRed/Green/Blue).
